note: The open items the logic pages carry, shown on those pages only and never appended to data/gaps.json (plan 12.0); lands_on names screen ids, logic_tech for the Tech page, logic_access for the Access page, V for the client views.

to be decided: the stale cap in days
to be decided: Hold as the default when a fund leaves the list, and when an Exit is ever advised (G12 on the board reads: not on the approved list, exit)
to be decided: the dimensions beyond risk band and horizon, and a ceiling on the number of cohorts
to be decided: how many model portfolios, and whether a mix change ever moves existing units
to be decided: who publishes when the principal officer is unreachable
to be decided: whether planning rows in L02 are reviewed by the financial planning function before publish
to be decided: the allowlist's home (M03 as decided on 7 Oct 2026, or the staff and seats screen), and one sign-in for both panels against L01's "same auth as the app"
to be decided: where the client reason slots live and who edits them ({I15} or the panel)
to be verified: what satisfies "digitally signed" for the rationale record of a release
to be verified: whether a change to the score-to-band thresholds needs the client's fresh confirmation before it applies
to be verified: the wording that tells clients how and when a plan is updated (the fixed-fee agreement, gap G06)
to be decided: the wave plan per kind of push; a call task after every urgent update or only one not accepted after three days
to be decided: whether the Adviser, Call centre and Support seats read the live rationale in the panel or as content in {I15}
to be decided: the review cadence per lane, and whether the monthly market inputs take the second person

to be decided: where the logic values live at run time: passed by the app to {I04} on every run, or held in {I04} as central defaults with a copy per client (7 Oct 2026 call); which system holds the snapshot of record

to be verified: whether {I04} can run a stored input snapshot at an as-of date, as a dry run, in a batch; whether a call recalculates or returns the stored result until a review is run; whether a review reads the central value of the day or the client's own copy
to be verified: whether a running SIP can be redirected through {I02} in one step, and how a Hold reaches a basket on {I03}
to be decided: whether a one-fund sleeve is acceptable under the per-product cap
to be decided: whether a scheduled release can be edited before its effective time or must be withdrawn and redrafted; whether a first plan built in that window uses the scheduled values
to be decided: whether approval is blocked until the reviewer has opened every preview panel; a hard limit on a single-class move
to be decided: whether a correction carries its own client explanation and a watch on grievances
to be verified: the record list and the minimum retention against the nine records on the Admin and CRM tab (brief H6); whether a saved reveal is one of them
to be decided: how the principal officer is reached for an urgent request
to be decided: the rule for staging an exit across financial years (not modelled)
to be verified: {I04} run time per plan, and how many runs it takes in parallel
to be verified: real snapshot and PDF sizes once the plan JSON contract exists (W03)
to be verified: a second-factor prompt at the moment of publish through {I14}
to be decided: what follows when an urgent Hold is not ratified within two working days
to be decided: whether a self-reported SIP outside the app counts as a running SIP for a Hold
to be decided: whether a staff seat may change an assumption for one client (the engine allows a client-wise change; 7 Oct 2026 call), and with what record
to be decided: when the letter for a house-view release is sent: on the effective date to every plan it will change, or to each client when their plan takes it up
to be decided: whether R12's sample plans are regenerated by a release from fixed sample inputs, or stay hand-maintained content (gap G08)
to be decided: what a saved reveal shows once the assumptions behind it have moved, and whether the nudges keep quoting its numbers

to be verified: whether launch runs execution in the app as section E draws, or through a link that opens {I02} with the portfolio loaded (gap G10; 7 Oct 2026 call); what the app then knows about a running SIP

to be verified: the field changes to L02 to L09 now in progress (7 Oct 2026 call), so the side screens draw the same rows

to be decided: session rules for staff: the idle timeout, one session at a time, the age of the second-factor check
to be decided: whether giving someone an operating seat needs a second person (it is the one way around the two-person rule)

to be decided: what the engine does with an amount below a fund's minimum SIP
to be decided: which releases need a compliance acknowledgement before publish, beyond assumptions and risk scoring
